description: When and how progress is preserved.
prompt_template:
Given this pacing pick:
{prior_picks.pacing_style}

Generate {count} save behavior options covering:
- Save trigger: gameWillTerminate_only | every_scene_change | every_minute | manual_save_points | hybrid
- Slot count: 1 (always overwrite) | 3 | named_slots
- What is saved: state_only | state_plus_screenshot (uses datastore.writeImage) | full_replay
- Save indicator: none | brief_text | animated_icon | sound
- scenes_with_save_points: array of scene ids if trigger=manual_save_points (else empty)
- lua_implementation: brief Lua snippet showing the save call pattern

Return a JSON array of exactly {count} options matching option_schema.
refinement_prompt: Revise the save behavior option below per the user feedback. Keep saves_screenshot consistent with 'what is saved' field.

option_schema.name: string
option_schema.trigger: enum: gameWillTerminate_only | every_scene_change | every_minute | manual_save_points | hybrid
